Re:Color

A paint app for people with color-vision difficulties.

@@ -14,14 +19,18 @@ Re:Color is a desktop paint application dedicated to supporting users with color-blindness and color-vision difficulties. It includes live color simulation for different types of color vision (deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia), plus tools like a color namer.
